'''Drach Coven''' was the captain of the ''[[Far Ranger]]'' during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. He was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and was aided in his job by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Mok]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Coven and Mok were arrested and executed for crimes against the [[Mercantile Guild]], shortly after handing [[Nick Rostu]] over to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]].
